issue.title: Clean up TLS config bookkeeping when a REST Client is closed

body:
Can you give https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/49874 a try please?

Also, keep in mind that if you are manually creating instances of the REST Client, you need to call `close()` when you are done with it.

> but this interface not have close method. how i can call close?



Cast it to `Closeable`
I have added a test to https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/49874 that does exactly ^
Using your reproducer, I verified that my fix works, thanks a lot!
The code is needed, yes. We can certainly convert the lambda into a `private static class` if needed.
I have a general question: What is your use case for manually creating multiple instances of the REST Client?

@geoand 
We have implemented workflows by AI agent based on langgraph4j and the quarkus langchain4j extension, which has client implementations for various LLMs. If you create an AiModel dynamically for dynamically connecting tools, it turns out that each time a client is created through QuarkusRestClientBuilder, which does not die after the workflow is completed.

we have custom extension for our LLM
an extension similar to
[Ollama](https://github.com/quarkiverse/quarkus-langchain4j/blob/main/model-providers/ollama/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkiverse/langchain4j/ollama/OllamaClient.java)

you can see all the model providers create client by QuarkusRestClientBuilder
As I understand it create new client for new chat whit user
